segments.an4.20:1.1: “Catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhattuddesako yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
segments.an4.20:1.3: Chandāgatiṃ gacchati, dosāgatiṃ gacchati, mohāgatiṃ gacchati, bhayāgatiṃ gacchati – imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhattuddesako yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
segments.an4.20:2.1: “Catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhattuddesako yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
segments.an4.20:2.3: Na chandāgatiṃ gacchati, na dosāgatiṃ gacchati, na mohāgatiṃ gacchati, na bhayāgatiṃ gacchati – imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhattuddesako yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge”ti.
segments.an4.20:3.3: Chandā dosā mohā ca bhayā gāmino [chandā ca dosā ca bhayā ca gāmino (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī)],
segments.an4.20:3.4: Parisākasaṭo [parisakkasāvo (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] ca panesa vuccati.
segments.an4.20:4.3: Dhamme ṭhitā ye na karonti pāpakaṃ,
segments.an4.20:4.4: Na chandā na dosā na mohā na bhayā ca gāmino [na chandadosā na bhayā ca gāmino (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)];
segments.an4.20:5.1: Caraṃ sīlaṃ padhānāni, saṃvaraṃ paññatti pañcamaṃ;
segments.an4.20:5.3: Sokhummaṃ tayo agatī, bhattuddesena te dasāti.

lines: Parisākasaṭo ca panesa vuccatīti ayañca pana so evarūpā parisākacavaro nāma vuccatīti attho.
Parisāya maṇḍo ca panesa vuccatīti ayaṃ evarūpā parisā vippasannena parisāmaṇḍoti vuccatīti.
